# hostinger_vps_post_install_script (Data Source)

Retrieves a VPS post-install script.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Post-install script ID.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Post-install script content.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the post-install script was created (RFC3339).
- `name` (String) Post-install script name.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the post-install script was updated (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
